verdict.rationale: uv's own docs describe `uv.lock` as a cross-platform lockfile with exact dependency information. They also say `uv add` updates both the lockfile and the project environment, and that targeted upgrades keep the rest of the lockfile intact, which together support reproducible resolutions across machines. The pack never documents a command that installs an environment strictly from the lockfile, and nothing confirms identical installs across machines. missing for 10: documented lockfile-only install/sync command (e.g. frozen/locked mode), enforcement that installs fail if the lockfile is stale, independent hands-on corroboration of identical versions across machines

support.subject: As a developer, I can install dependencies from a lockfile and get the exact same resolved versions on every machine

citations.quote: `uv.lock` is a cross-platform lockfile that contains exact information about your project's dependencies.
This will also update the lockfile and project environment
while keeping the rest of the lockfile intact
